'''Karie Neth''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as a member of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After leading a group of Alliance prisoners in an escape from an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Maw Imperial Prison|prison]],<ref name="RS2">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]''</ref> she replaced a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] pilot who had been lost on a mission ordered by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion's]] command staff, and participated in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="CCG" />

==Biography==
{{Quote|My name is Karie Neth. I'm the leader of the prisoners here.|Karie Neth|<ref name="RS2" />}}
[[File:Karie-Neth-RotJ.png|thumb|left|150px|Karie takes her seat at the pre-Endor briefing.]]
After the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], several members of the Alliance including Neth were captured from [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and taken to a [[Maw Imperial Prison|prison]] on a planetoid hidden in an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] field near [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]]. The Alliance leadership suspected that there was an installation in that area, and three [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] members led by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] were sent to investigate. After fighting past Imperial ships to reach the planetoid the Rebels received a transmission from Neth begging for someone to hear her. She identified herself to Antilles as the leader of the prisoners and asked Antilles and his wingmen to destroy the guard towers protecting the prison building. She then transmitted targeting information to the Rebels' [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]].<ref name="RS2" />

Once the Rogues destroyed the prison's defenses, Neth and the others commandeered an [[armored hovertrain]] and headed to a landing platform as the fighter pilots held off the Imperial forces. The prisoners finally stole an [[Imperial loader shuttle]] and escaped the planetoid as Wedge and the Rogues held off [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptors]].<ref name="RS2" />

[[File:Ewok_celebration_SW_Twitter.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Neth celebrates the victory at Endor]]
After replacing a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] pilot lost during a secret mission, she attended the Rebel briefing on [[Home One/Legends|''Home One'']] prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|assault]] on the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]], conversing with [[Ten Numb/Legends|Ten Numb]] before the briefing began. She was wearing an orange [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot's]] flight suit, as she was at the time an X-wing pilot.<ref name="Databank" /> During the Battle of Endor, Neth was assigned to [[Gray Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gray Squadron]], serving as gunner aboard [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Telsij/Legends|Telsij's]] [[Gray Squadron 2|Y-wing]].<ref name="CCG" /> She would go on to survive the battle, and join many of the Rebels celebrating their victory with the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] in [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|You know, the Rebellion may be led by a robed ex-Senator and a Princess without a homeworld, but for all that girl power on top, the rank-and-file pilots have been decidedly testosterone-heavy. Miss Neth brings a little gender equity to the game (and Rogue Squadron) and serves as a back-up pilot for Gray Squadron 2.|[[Cory J. Herndon]], on Karie Neth|<ref name="DP">{{GamerCite|2|Deck Plans}}</ref>}}
Karie Neth was played uncredited by [[Lynne Hazelden]] in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']]. In [[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader|''Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader'']], she was voiced by [[Grey Griffin|Grey DeLisle]].

An interview with Hazelden for the Star Wars Aficionado fan site confirmed that she also appeared in costume in the Ewok celebration scene in ''Return of the Jedi''<ref name="SWAficionado">{{Blogspot|subdomain=starwarsaficionado|url=2013/03/aficionado-classic-behind-scenes-info_23.html|name=Star Wars Aficionado|text=Classic Behind the Scenes Info Part Nine}}</ref>, and a photo of her in that scene was shared by the ''Star Wars'' Twitter account.<ref name="Celebration Twitter">{{Twitter|starwars|status/695391644057673731|Star Wars|quote=#ThrowbackThursday - No one throws a victory party like the Ewoks. Great BBQ.|archivedate=20190723220106}}</ref>
